name: criterion-8
text: Criterion 8 (O-1A 8, EB-1A ix): high salary or other remuneration.

Counts: salary plus equity above the 90th percentile for the job code (CareerOneStop, BLS); founder equity as comparable evidence (D-equity-comparable); venture funding toward remuneration (D-funding-remuneration); for O-1A only, a signed contract for future pay (X-future-pay, EB-1A building until paid).
Rejected (T-revenue-not-pay): company revenue counted as personal pay; pay below the peer benchmark.
